info.title: KAG Unified API
info.description:
Unified REST API gateway for the Knowledge Augmented Generation (KAG) platform.

Routes requests to 11 backend microservices:

| Service | Port | Prefix | Description |
|---------|------|--------|-------------|
| **Ingestion** | 8555 | `/ingest` | Multi-format document parsing, web scraping, image classification |
| **KAG Graph** | 8803 | `/graph` | Neo4j knowledge graph construction, semantic search, Cypher |
| **HiRAG** | 8802 | `/query` | 4-level hierarchical document decomposition and retrieval |
| **KARMA** | 8801 | `/process` | 35-agent LLM-powered document enrichment pipeline |
| **NLP** | 8805 | `/process` | NER, tokenization, POS tagging, sentiment (delegates to ML backend) |
| **Graph Adapter** | 8804 | `/graph` | Multi-tenant Neo4j REST API with analytics and bulk ops |
| **ML Backend** | 9100/9101 | `/ml` | Embeddings, similarity, GNN, attention (PyTorch or MLX) |
| **Orchestrator** | 8806 | `/kag` | Multi-stage pipeline coordination (KARMA → HiRAG → KAG Graph) |
| **Discovery Engine** | 8807 | `/discover` | Academic paper discovery, snowball search, trust scoring |
| **Scientific Processor** | 8808 | `/scientific` | Graph topology analysis, verification (CoVe, RAGAS, Z3/SymPy), GNN explainability, statistical meta-analysis |
| **Media Discovery** | 8809 | `/media` | Multimedia search, quality scoring, transcript extraction, playlist import |

**Authentication:** Istio-forwarded headers (`x-user-id`, `x-tenant-id`, `x-user-roles`) with trusted-network bypass for RFC1918/loopback IPs.
Protected: `/ingest`, `/query`, `/process`, `/kag`, `/graph`, `/ml`, `/discover`, `/scientific`, `/media`.
Public: `/health`, `/docs`, `/redoc`, `/openapi.json`.

**Multi-tenancy:** `X-Tenant-ID` header (defaults to uuid7 `0195f48b-d000-7000-8000-000000000001`, the n8n-dev tenant).

API root endpoint providing service information and available endpoints.

Returns basic information about the API, including version, status,
documentation links, and available endpoint categories.

Returns:
    Dict[str, Any]: A dictionary containing:
        - service: Service name
        - version: API version string
        - status: Operational status
        - documentation: Links to API documentation (Swagger UI, ReDoc, OpenAPI spec)
        - endpoints: Dictionary of available endpoint categories and their base paths

Example:
    >>> GET /
    {
        "service": "KAG Unified API",
        "version": "1.0.0",
        "status": "operational",
        "documentation": {...},
        "endpoints": {...}
    }

AsyncJobSummary.title: AsyncJobSummary
AsyncJobSummary.description:
The ``result`` an ASYNC ingestion job carries — a summary, never the parsed text.

The async file path writes ``result`` twice and NEITHER shape is a ParsedDocument:
``{"object_key": ...}`` at create time, then a short completion summary once the Celery
worker has parsed (ingestion_service ``processing_tasks.py`` ~:406). Only the SYNC path
returns a full :class:`ParsedDocumentData`.

Modelling both shapes as ParsedDocumentData is what broke this endpoint: ``text`` is
required there, the async result has none, so response-model validation rejected the
payload and ``GET /ingest/documents/jobs/{job_id}`` returned **500 for every
fr-uploaded document, at every stage of its life**. fr swallows the error, so its
documents never left "processing" and ``documents.kag_document_id`` stayed NULL forever.

ModelsResponse.title: ModelsResponse
ModelsResponse.description:
Response for available models.

Mirrors the downstream `/api/ml/models` contract: `models` carries the
full per-model metadata (including a `loaded` flag), and the optional
`available_models` / `current_model` fields surface the names-only

quick "what's loaded" list keep working without the downstream having

QueryType.description:
Structured, tenant-scoped graph query types.

Raw ``cypher``/``dsl`` were retired: they cannot be tenant-scoped at the

graph-adapter structured endpoint that bakes ``tenant_id`` into the query.

RetrievalDiagnostics.title: RetrievalDiagnostics
RetrievalDiagnostics.description:
Always-present retrieval summary so a caller (and the UI) can tell WHY an
answer was or wasn't produced — without enabling full debug.

Distinguishes the failure modes that all otherwise collapse to the same
"I don't have enough information" string:
  * ``no_matching_content`` — retrieval found nothing for this tenant/scope
    (empty library, wrong tenant, over-narrow doc/level filter).
  * ``insufficient_context`` — passages were retrieved but the model judged
    them insufficient to answer (the content doesn't cover the question).
``abstained=False`` means a real answer was synthesized.
